title: Station Need: Ember Gland at The Crucible Garrison filled from the pilot's glands stored at Krynn (2 jumps), about 5,600 cr a gland
note: Written by Mercury, 2026-11-24 07:16 UTC (orders ENT-085 block MERCURY: sell handed goods at or above the bids). The Crucible Garrison posts Station Need: Ember Gland for 10 glands (56,361 cr), 2 (11,072) and 1 (5,607) (board read 06:50 UTC), 13 glands for 73,040 cr; its bid is 480 and the best bid anywhere 5,367 (Hex Star). A trader's storage at Krynn holds 13 glands (storage book 07:06 UTC). The runner accepts the first copy posted under the title once the hold has the stop's `needs`; each redock hands one copy in, so three accept-and-redock pairs fill the three copies largest need first (the Krynn form, need-ember-gland-krynn, proven by hand 2026-11-23). Risk: a new copy larger than the glands left could be accepted half-filled; read the first RESULT. What is left is stored at The Crucible. Krynn to The Crucible 2 jumps, Crimson space. One ship.
